question: According to the San Bernardino County Employees' Retirement Association (SBCERA) investment consultant RFP, approximately how large is SBCERA's investment portfolio?
acceptance: $12bn approximately suffices; do not require or invent an as-of date.
candidate_answer: SBCERA’s investment portfolio was approximately **$12.0 billion**. [Source: SBCERA investment consultant RFP, p. 3](SBCERA__investment_consultant_-_request_for_proposals.pdf).
